typography.rules: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for Headings. Use Outfit for Headings and Manrope for Body.

colors.archetype: High-Contrast Functional Dashboard with Electric Blue
colors.rules: Use Electric Blue (hsl(221, 100%, 55%)) as the primary brand and action color. Tint dark mode grays with a hint of blue. Ensure high contrast for data readability. NEVER use pure #000000 or #808080.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Neumorphism (Tactile)' or 'Grid Borders' for dashboard widgets. Cards should have flat backgrounds with 1px subtle borders (border-border) and no shadow by default. On hover, apply a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 with 1px delicate inner stroke) for sticky headers and floating navs. Do NOT use transparent backgrounds without blur/scrim.
visual_enhancers.charts: Use Recharts for the radar/spider chart of CPL/CPMK attainment. Ensure chart colors use the Electric Blue mixed with complementary colors (e.g., Teal, Orange) from the Shadcn chart scale.
visual_enhancers.badges: Use highly visible, color-coded badges for Early Warning System (Red/Danger for below threshold, Green/Success for on-track).

component_strategy.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Dense and compact for Assessment Matrix and grade inputs. Sticky headers for long class lists.
component_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, and Checkbox. Never use native inputs. Use Shadcn Calendar for date picking.
component_strategy.tabs: Override default fixed heights (h-9 to h-auto) for TabList to prevent text cutoff. Use tabs to separate 16 Meetings in the teaching materials view.
component_strategy.tree_view: For CPL-CPMK-Sub-CPMK mapping, use a custom collapsible tree structure with clear indentation and connecting border lines (border-l).
component_strategy.dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialogs for CQI/Remediation assignments and Rubric editing to avoid navigating away from the context.

grids.dashboard_mode: High Density Grid (For Dashboards/Analytics). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids.widget_spans: Summary metrics: col-span-1. Primary chart (Spider chart/Progress): col-span-2 row-span-2. Feed/List (Early warnings): col-span-1 row-span-2.

layouts.navigation: Dashboard requires a Sidebar (collapsible on mobile) and a Sticky Top Header (z-50, backdrop-blur-xl). Header must include Light/Dark toggle, User Profile Avatar, and Notifications.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Page wrappers should have p-4 md:p-8.
layouts.alignment: Left-align tables, dense content, and forms. Center-align empty states or specific modal headers.

motion.transitions: Use transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. NO 'transition: all'.
motion.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST explicitly set color/bg on hover (e.g., hover:bg-primary/90).
motion.micro_interactions: Entrance animations for list items in the Assessment Matrix. Smooth expand/collapse for the CPL mapping tree.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for text. Explicit focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboards and developer tools. Install via yarn add @phosphor-icons/react.
media.images: Hero images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.

3d_libraries.strategy: Not strictly required for this data-heavy LMS, but Visx or Recharts are MANDATORY for the Radar/Spider charts to visualize student capabilities. Avoid heavy 3D to keep performance high.

login_hero.description: Group of young students walking on campus sidewalk on a bright day. Use as background or side panel for the Login screen.

dashboard_banner.description: Sunlit university campus. Can be used for a welcome banner in the student dashboard.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure standard components from Shadcn UI are customized to fit the 'High-Contrast Functional Dashboard' archetype.
Build a robust layout with a collapsible sidebar and sticky top header with Dark/Light mode toggle.
The CPL-CPMK mapping must visually represent the hierarchy clearly using nested layouts or a tree structure.
The Assessment Matrix is a critical view—use dense, horizontally scrollable tables if necessary.
For the Radar/Spider chart, use Recharts.
Electric Blue (hsl(221, 100%, 55%)) is the primary color. Apply it to buttons, active states, and chart highlights. Override tailwind config with it.
Include STKIP PGRI Pacitan tagline 'Kampus Humanis dan Religius' prominently in the login page or header.
All code MUST be written in JavaScript (.js/.jsx), not TypeScript (.tsx).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for elements with content below them.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Prioritize Information Architecture. For a data-heavy LMS, ensure logical grouping of features like OBE settings, Grades, and Portfolios.
Provide clear feedback for user actions (e.g., Toast notifications for grade updates, loading skeletons).
Maintain consistent alignment and spacing. Forms should have inputs clearly labeled and left-aligned.
Reduce Cognitive Load by progressively disclosing information. Use tabs (e.g., for 16 Meetings) and collapsibles (e.g., for sub-CPMKs).
Ensure mobile responsiveness using stacked layouts on smaller screens while retaining full data tables through horizontal scrolling.
